data.one_liner: A large library of brand and industry logos as Flutter assets.
data.what_it_does: Provides a large library of popular industry and brand logos (sports, fashion, tech, daily, media, auto, crypto, etc.) organized into static classes for easy rendering as images.
use_when: You need standard company or brand logos in your Flutter application.
Building quiz, catalog, eCommerce, or template apps requiring industry-related images.
avoid_when: You require fully dynamic or remote logo loading via URL rather than embedded assets.
Package size constraints are extremely strict and you only need a single custom logo.
strengths: Huge collection of pre-packaged popular brand and industry logos.
Simple static class API for quick integration.
weaknesses: Increases overall asset bundle size due to embedded PNG images.
Limited to the specific logos provided by the package.
